subject: english
title: Unit 9 Writing — Cause and Effect (A Game I Enjoy)
subtitle: v1 · 56 slides · Objectives → 5 related action words → 3 academic words → the 5 connectors (because · as · so · so that · as a result) → Warm Up → Present (two-column chart) → Read the Model (SB p.158, Isabelle's tetherball paragraphs) → Workbook pp.114–115 word map and chart → Plan → a/an/the → Write → Edit → Share → Recap → Formative Assessment · every word pre-taught as a mini-game before it is needed

content: Analyse a writing model — Isabelle's cause-and-effect paragraphs about tetherball (SB p.158).
Plan and write a paragraph of cause and effect about a game or activity Leo enjoys.
Evaluate the writing against a 4-point edit checklist before sharing it aloud.
language: Use the cause connectors because and as, and the effect connectors so, so that and as a result.
Punctuate as a result correctly: full stop before, comma after.
Distinguish so (it happened) from so that (you wanted it to happen).
Use a and an on first mention and the every time after that.
Use the academic words cause and effect, critical thinking, description to talk about writing.
Read the related action words in context: bounce, dive, slide, practice, dizzy.
